description: Read changes to open/forthcoming EU Funding & Tenders Portal calls: additions, deadlines, status and removals. Use this for grants; tenders_list_deadline_changes monitors procurement submissions and compliance_list_deadlines lists statutory dates. Filters narrow together; identifier matches a prefix and field selects changed fields. Returns changes with before/after topic records, official topic URLs, observed_at, count/has_more/next_cursor and feed check time. Reuse next_cursor with the same filters to page or poll stored observations; this is not a current-call catalogue or live Portal search. For one known topic id from the result, use HTTP GET /v1/eu/funding/topics/{id}; that detail route is documented in /openapi.json. Free keyless allowance: 100 successful answers/day when metered, unlimited otherwise. API keys retain their credit policy. No MCP payment flow; exhaustion returns the HTTP alternative.

change.description: One kind of change only Allowed: added, amended, removed; e.g. added.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from this tool's prior answer; f followed by 1 to 12 digits, e.g. f0. Keep filters unchanged; omit on first call.

field.description: Only changes to this field Allowed: deadlines, status, opens, deadline_model, title, call_title, kind, url; e.g. deadlines.

identifier.description: Topic/call identifier prefix, 2 to 200 ASCII letters/digits or . _ -, e.g. HORIZON-CL5-2026; omit for all topics

since.description: Changes observed on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 7 days ago); e.g. 2026-10-01. Must be a parseable YYYY-MM-DD date.

name: funding_list_changes
title: List EU funding call changes
